the transformations that occurred between 1945 to 1960 in the field of Brazilian fine arts.
the transformations that took place in the Brazilian fine arts during the period in question, and with the role played by the critics in this transformation.
the transformations of the Brazilian artistic field, from the 1940s until the mid-1960s, in the context of the internationalization of the artistic production, in the middle of the 20th century.
